script_text: Halt, Taurus! The stars are screaming a vital message today. Venus, your sensual earth ruler, forms a potent sextile with transformative Pluto in your 8th House of Shared Resources, unlocking deep financial shifts. This aspect trines expansive Jupiter in your 11th House of Networks, so alliances could bring unexpected gains. In love, Venus energizes your 5th House of Romance; singles may attract a stable, artistic soul through creative circles, while couples should nurture intimacy with heartfelt gestures. Career-wise, the 10th House of Reputation is charged by Saturn's discipline—negotiate that raise or solidify a long-term project. Avoid impulsive luxury buys; Neptune's fog clouds judgment. Subscribe for tomorrow's reading to harness the cosmic flow.
